notes:
CIRCUIT: single-loop ladder inside a hand-drawn border rectangle (the border is ink but touches no component and stays off every net). 83 A source drives 96 mH + 95 mH in series into a node that feeds 87 ohm to ground and 86 ohm to the 80 kV source, whose bottom goes through the 91 F capacitor back to the ground rail.

NET MAP
  n1 = top of the 83 A source (#4) and left lead of the 96 mH inductor (#0); the y~388 rail from x~185 to x~264.
  n2 = right lead of #0, left lead of the 95 mH inductor (#1).
  n3 = right lead of #1, left lead of the 86 ohm resistor (#2), top lead of the 87 ohm resistor (#3); the node at S0 (626,393).
  n4 = right lead of #2, top of the 80 kV source (#5); the corner at (825,388).
  n5 = bottom of #5, top plate of the 91 F capacitor (#6).
  0  = the bottom rail y~650: bottom of the 83 A source (#4), bottom lead of the 87 ohm resistor (#3), bottom plate of #6, and GND #7.

SITE DECISIONS (all CRITICAL sites explicit)
  S0 (626,393) junction - clean T: the 87 ohm top lead ends on the top rail, nothing passes through. A crossing reading would strand the resistor's top lead on a one-terminal net and leave the 87 ohm branch with no path to the source.
  S3 (637,647) junction - T where the 87 ohm bottom lead lands on the bottom rail. Crossing would leave the 87 ohm bottom dangling.
  S4 (614,651) junction - the GND #7 stub meets the same bottom rail 23 px to the left of S3; deg=4 only because the rail is drawn as two slightly offset strokes. Crossing would disconnect the GND symbol, leaving the whole circuit with no net '0'.
  S1 (899,580) junction (non-critical) - this is the '91 F' handwriting brushing the capacitor's right side; no terminal uses it, so the reading has no effect.
  No dots and no hops are drawn anywhere on this sheet; every intersection here is an unambiguous T.

PORTS/CLASSES: nothing overridden. The only tracer warning was two spare port candidates on resistor #3 at (662,490)/(662,471), which are strokes of the handwritten '87 ohm' label touching the box - the real leads (top p1, bottom p0) were already selected. All 8 symbols match their drawn shape (2 Inductor, 2 Resistor, I-DC, V-DC, Capacitor, GND).

UNRESOLVED: none.
